prompts: Use case: sketch-to-render. Turn this exact measured orthographic 2:1 box into a realistic Ming-dynasty Jiangnan merchant house map sprite. Retain PRECISE blue bottom rectangle vertices (138,604),(838,954),(1398,674),(698,324), both ground-axis slopes+0.500/-0.500 and width:depth10:8. This is a CAD architectural render with PARALLEL projection. The blue bottom outline becomes a thin grey stone foundation edge; remove all blue/grey sketch lines. White lime plaster two-storey merchant residence, broad dark charcoal fine clay tiled gable roof, stepped white firebreak gable walls at both ends, brown straight timber lattice upper windows, simple ground-floor wooden door on lower-left facade, small side service wing inside rectangle. Modest eaves, fine realistic matte weathered materials and exquisite tile detail, visually like a historically grounded strategy game sprite, NOT stylized cartoon. Ground stone rim is FLAT not a thick island. Footprint entrance faces lower-left. Texture lower-left face10m and lower-right face8m according to guide. Vertical walls stay vertical. Upper-left light with very short lower-right contact shadow contained within footprint. TRUE alpha transparency: outside object alpha0, interior alpha255. No background haze, aura, glow, vignette, surroundings, writing, labels, grid, people, watermarks. Complete outline visible in canvas. One isolated building.

Precise geometry correction of this Ming Jiangnan house. The front is TOO LONG and the depth TOO SHORT. SHORTEN the front facade by20%, DEEPEN the right-facing side by20%, producing registered footprint10 metres front by8 metres depth. Camera yaw45 with exact 2:1 projection: ALL ground lines slope+0.5/-0.5 with perfectly vertical walls. New base on1536x1024: left(170,600), front(850,940), right(1394,668), hidden back(714,328). This is a genuine camera/architecture rebuild, not preserving old projection. Horizontal front component680, side544, ratio1.25. Two storeys with only THREE wide upper lattice window groups on front, strong wider white firebreak gable and side wing within footprint. Same fine realistic tiles, weathered matte white lime walls, dark brown timber, subdued Jiangnan detail. Steps inside plain thin rectangular stone rim; no projecting side foyer beyond rectangle. No thick plinth. Entire asset zoomed out safely inside frame. Upper-left light, lower-right tiny contact shadow. Preserve true alpha, no surrounding glow or haze. No text, no diagrams, no grid, people or modern objects. One complete building.
